collections.name: Erdős Problems

collections.name: Formal Conjectures
collections.trust_role: canonical proof-assistant artifact source; not an authority on fidelity or current open status

collections.name: OEIS Open Problems
collections.trust_role: large Lean candidate pool requiring significance, fidelity and solved-result filtering
collections.snapshot_note: 492 Lean statements; the 2026-08 paper reports 147 resolved, so no entry is promoted from the raw set automatically

collections.name: FrontierMath Open Problems
collections.trust_role: small, precise expert-authored source; status is volatile and public verifiers may need reconstruction
collections.snapshot_note: only individually audited pages enter the curated layer
collections.license: Epoch AI content reuse with attribution; verify page terms for artifacts

collections.name: AIM: AI and Number Theory 2026 problem list
collections.trust_role: expert workshop list explicitly stratified by where AI may help
collections.snapshot_note: 71 prompts; only precise construction or bounded-milestone cards are selected
collections.license: link and paraphrase only unless AIM grants broader reuse

collections.name: AlphaEvolve Repository of Problems
collections.trust_role: source of construction-search task patterns and evaluators, not a blanket list of still-open targets
collections.snapshot_note: freeze an exact dimension, field and current record before promoting a target
collections.license: Apache-2.0 / CC BY as marked upstream

collections.name: Optimization Problems in Mathematics
collections.trust_role: living source for bound-improvement tasks; starred and newly updated claims need independent checking
collections.snapshot_note: record improvement and exact determination must be separate targets

collections.name: Ben Green's 100 open problems
collections.trust_role: expert source with a substantial Lean subset; many entries remain too asymptotic for direct agent search
collections.snapshot_note: use the author list for intent and the Lean files only as formal artifacts
collections.license: link and paraphrase; Lean repository terms apply to formal artifacts

collections.name: Dynamic Survey of Small Ramsey Numbers
collections.trust_role: authoritative dynamic bound reference for finite Ramsey targets
collections.snapshot_note: consult again immediately before an attack

collections.name: House of Graphs cage table

collections.name: Table of large graphs with given degree and diameter
collections.trust_role: maintainer-run record table with adjacency lists and some Sage verification scripts
